name: Forms
description: Visual form builder (Modules › Forms) with conditional fields, file uploads, multi-step forms, validation, email notifications and confirmations, spam protection, entry limits and an inbox with stars, filters and CSV export. Place forms with the Form button in the editor, [form slug="…"], {{form:slug}} or a Form custom field.
author: Slate

changelog.2.0.0: Visual drag and drop builder with live preview, 17 field types (file upload, date, time, heading, page break and more), width per field, validation rules, conditional show/hide, multi-step forms, templates for new forms. Redirect or message after sending, notification emails with field tags and Reply-To, confirmation email to the visitor, entry limit and close date, time trap spam check. Inbox: starred entries, date filter, file downloads. Editor: form picker with search, preview and quick create. Works without JavaScript (server-side validation with inline errors). Existing forms and entries keep working unchanged.
